hypothesis.claim: A decoder-synchronized exact far-history match specialist can recover useful continuations more than 16,777,216 transformed bytes old that FXCM's ring-buffer reads necessarily alias, expose at least 254,953 active byte opportunities, and beat matched ring-alias, random, and negated controls under a bounded direct-mapped index.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire this exact 16-byte-key, 2^24-entry, direct-mapped information source if either full transformed-stream scan differs, fewer than 254,953 treatment bytes activate, treatment fails any matched control, a chronological third or the required far-distance buckets are dead, exact verification or causal ordering fails, or the frozen resource bounds are exceeded.

changedMechanism: Add exact decoder-visible addressing of already decoded transformed history beyond the parent's 16 MiB ring; do not checkpoint CMIX, alter the parent, tune an optimizer, transmit copy commands, change the key, or sweep table and replacement rules.
invariants: The scanner consumes the exact 587,138,826-byte transformed-ready population with SHA-256 7826ff63dedd526c119dda08e6e044be8fa8f6e89a55f3d6b1f3447cdfc5c1ce.
At position i, every key byte, verification byte, continuation byte, table record, and continuation decision was created strictly before i from already consumed transformed bytes.
A lookup must compare all 16 context bytes with exact prior history before treatment activation; a hash or tag collision suppresses prediction.
Treatment activates only when current position minus the referenced continuation position exceeds 16,777,216 bytes.
The current truth is scored before any insertion or continuation-state update derived from that truth.

The direct-mapped table has exactly 2^24 eight-byte records containing a 32-bit verification tag and a 32-bit continuation position; collision replacement and sentinel encoding are frozen before execution.
K performs the same causal history, hash, lookup, verification, replacement, continuation, and counter work as D while emitting no prediction.
R, S, and N score exactly the treatment-selected positions; control outcomes cannot affect activation, continuation, replacement, or future treatment state.
The scanner and every control have zero arithmetic-archive and objective authority.
The optimistic 16 archive bytes per active byte comes from eight bit predictions times the parent's 16-bit actual-bit surprisal floor and is only a futility envelope.

controls.definition: Predict the exact byte at the verified prior continuation position more than 16 MiB behind the current transformed position.
Execute identical causal state transitions, file history, table lookup, exact verification, collision replacement, continuation, and counters with prediction disabled.
At each D-selected position, read D's same absolute continuation through the parent's 16 MiB ring alias, isolating exact far addressability from opportunity selection.
At each D-selected position, emit a deterministic SplitMix64 byte derived from the pre-opportunity state and fixed seed.
At each D-selected position, emit the bitwise complement of D's exact continuation byte.
A fresh second process repeats the complete scan and must reproduce normalized receipts, counters, thirds, distance buckets, state digests, and opportunity digests exactly.
